pages.title: Manual Controls
pages.text: One setting controls manual stop/start for standard and large fermentation barrels.$(br2)Edit growthcraft_cellar-common.toml under [fermentation_barrel]:$(br2)allow_manual_unlock = true$(br2)The default is false. Hopper automation remains enabled.

pages.title: Operator Command
pages.text: With operator permission, change the shared setting using:$(br2)/growthcraft cellar barrelManualUnlock true$(br2)Use false to disable the controls. The command saves the config. Both barrel sizes use the same value.

pages.title: Existing Configs
pages.text: The previous allow_large_barrel_manual_unlock value is migrated to allow_manual_unlock, with a backup saved before writing.$(br2)If both keys exist, the new key takes precedence.$(br2)The previous largeBarrelManualUnlock command remains an alias for the shared setting.
